name: app-design-process-staircase-of-pills-with-gradient-final-step
title: Five design-process pills rising in steps on dashed columns with a yellow-green gradient final step
whatItIs: A light grey slide 'Design Process 01' with dashed vertical column guides and five white rounded labels stepping up to the right (Research & Discovery, UX & Wireframing, Brand Identity, UI Design), the last 'Prototype & Finalization' filled with a yellow-to-green gradient.
whatItMeans: Simple and rising; the gradient step marks completion.
techniques: Step labels up diagonally on dashed columns.
Make the final step a gradient.
Keep others white and dark grey.

vocabulary.definition: A dashed vertical line as a layout guide.
Labels stepped upward across a slide.
The last item highlighted with a gradient.
A small green dot beside a heading.
